notes.title: Update Alpha 0.79 | Translation Update!
notes.content:
The Translation Update! You can now translate the game into whatever language you please!
To play different languages you need to replace the Lang.txt file with the Lang.txt file of a different language.

Fixed:
[list]
[*] Fixed the [1] line in help text not being listed in the right place
[*] Fixed Numerous spelling errors and typos
[/list]
Changed:
[list]
[*] Moved all text from in game to a translation file! You can now translate the file to have the game in whatever language you'd like.
[*] Changed the text for the Toggle Auto Look option to make it a bit more clear.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.70
notes.content:
Added:
[list]
[*] Added hate dialogue for each NPC that can talk
[*] Added love dialogue for each NPC that can talk
[*] Added CharLove for each NPC for every other NPC, it starts at 1. When causing fear the NPC's CharLove for your current character will drop by 0.1. If this number reaches or goes below 0, the npc will curse at you and generally hate you.
[*] Added certain dialogue options that increase CharLove. As CharLove increases above 1, sexual interactions with that character are made easier. For example, if an NPC has a CharLove of 1 then they will have to be very horny to have sex with them. However, if their CharLove is 3, they will only need to be 1/3 as horny. The CharLove system isn't fully implemented and not every character has the ability to gain CharLove through dialogue, but this is the foundation for the romance system.
[*] Added the Love spell. This will cause the NPC to fall in love with you.
[/list]

Fixed:
[list]
[*] You can now buy a room at the inn for $15
[/list]

Changed:
[list]
[*] Named the inn "Vandor Inn"
[*] Rewrote Sarna's dialogue
[*] Changed a line of Ella's dialogue to give +0.1 CharLove
[/list]

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.65 | Fixed 100% GPU issue
notes.content:
Added:
[list]
[*] Added locked doors. The gate to the castle is now locked
[*] Added option to change to fullscreen in the settings
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*] Fixed GPU jumping to 100% after changing resolution. The issue is that while Vsync was on at first it was being turned off after the resolution changed. This caused the game to try to run as fast as it can, and so it used all of the GPU to do so.([url=https://en.sfml-dev.org/forums/index.php?topic=29380.0]Thanks to G. on the SFML Forums[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2716780/discussions/0/7190626338002074080/]to Fractal on Steam[/url])
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Added locked doors. The gate to the castle is now locked
[*] Added option to change to fullscreen in the settings

tags.bug: [*] Fixed GPU jumping to 100% after changing resolution. The issue is that while Vsync was on at first it was being turned off after the resolution changed. This caused the game to try to run as fast as it can, and so it used all of the GPU to do so.([url=https://en.sfml-dev.org/forums/index.php?topic=29380.0]Thanks to G. on the SFML Forums[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2716780/discussions/0/7190626338002074080/]to Fractal on Steam[/url])
